problem_type: Shared account spend attributed to one image task
symptom: Fifth cover triggers excess-charge stop despite task cost matching quote
direct_cause: Script uses shared balance delta as task actualUsd
class_root: Task spend invariant lacks task-scoped provider cost ownership
affected_population: All cover jobs while another client uses the same account

external_sources.purpose: Task response includes cost and credits_cost distinct from shared balance

invariants: Task spend uses finite nonnegative provider cost and stays within reserved CNY
Shared account delta retained separately as diagnostic evidence
generality_proof: One charge function used for every initial and rework task; no job/model-specific exceptions.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate and attribute completed task fee

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Rework jobs enter the identical completion boundary

legacy_paths.rationale: Extend the existing parser; no alternate parser or bypass
